string-array.name: help_steps
string-array.item:
1. Generate the code.
Enter the vehicle VIN (17 characters) in the input field and tap "Generate code". The code *#XXXXXXXX#* will appear below. You can copy it with the "Copy" button.

2. Dial the code.
Open the "Phone" app on the head unit, switch to the dial pad and enter the generated code *#XXXXXXXX#* in full, including * and #. Press call — no actual call is made, the engineering menu opens instead.

3. Other discovered codes.
The "Phone" app also accepts:
• 111111#*# — DynoMode, roller bench mode (disables ESP/ABS intervention);
• 88888888*** — SmartLog, log collection and upload.
In the engineering menu, the password for the factory buttons tab ("Misc tests") is adayo7012.
